population.rationale: Original/v4 final receipts only, verified against immutable public archives; numeric forecasting only, no pooled quality or acceptance evidence; failed unknown usage remains in the study ledger

projection.formula: Base: 40 times each arm mean, summed. Stress: 40 * (original nearest-rank p90 + v4 nearest-rank p90) * 1.25 per dimension; total stressed input is cached + uncached stressed input for partition consistency.
projection.probabilityClaim: None: budgeting scenarios, not predictive confidence intervals or monetary bills; no saving extrapolated from the 4-call result

stopLineSemantics: Implemented and offline-verified in the unreleased source branch. Five cumulative whole-cohort lines are frozen in request/preview/native plan; reaching any line prevents the next agent call. One in-flight call may overshoot. Missing/partial/invalid final usage or executor/guard error stops further calls; failed and excluded spending is retained. No retry, replacement or automatic expansion. Not an API hard token cap or live spending authorization.
unknown: Full authoring/orchestration usage outside task executor receipts
